prompt: If Alice turned 36 on the day John F. Kennedy was assassinated, how old would she be on the day the Berlin Wall fell?
answer:
Alice would have been **61 years old** on November 9, 1989.

She turned 36 on November 22, 1963, so she was born on November 22, 1927. On the day the Berlin Wall fell—November 9, 1989—her 62nd birthday was still 13 days away.
